description: ZINT gives ChatGPT verified UK corporate intelligence for prospecting, M&A and restructuring research, investment analysis, and risk and compliance monitoring. Grounded in Companies House records and enriched with news, annual accounts and website signals, the app resolves free-text company names or domains to authoritative UK identifiers, searches the UK company database with structured financial, governance, sector, region and event-driven filters, retrieves selected company data fields, surfaces recent news by event category, previews annual accounts sections, fetches categorised website content, and checks the user's ZINT credit balance.
